Rain damages crops in Haryana and Punjab, farmers concerned

Heavy rainfall has impacted paddy and wheat crops in Gohana, Haryana, causing concern among farmers. In Fazilka, Punjab, rain has damaged grain markets, leading to an estimated loss of crores of rupees worth of paddy. Farmers in Haryana are facing increased difficulties due to delays in crop procurement alongside the damage caused by rain to the paddy harvest.
